commit cd81c6899232b2baa7c025ac52f6a1c72c05121b
Author:     Daniel Darnell <daniel@thunderbird.net>
AuthorDate: Tue Jun 10 04:10:33 2025 +0000
Commit:     Daniel Darnell <daniel@thunderbird.net>
CommitDate: Tue Jun 10 04:10:33 2025 +0000

    Bug 1967173 - Port bug 1966470: Make Desktop single-locale repacks fetch using artifact build logic rather than `wget-en-US`. r=darktrojan
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D253121

diff --git a/taskcluster/kinds/l10n/kind.yml b/taskcluster/kinds/l10n/kind.yml
index 0ce909aeb28..dfc27b35f0b 100644
--- a/taskcluster/kinds/l10n/kind.yml
+++ b/taskcluster/kinds/l10n/kind.yml
@@ -89,18 +89,12 @@ tasks:
                     win64: windows2012-64/opt
         env:
             by-build-platform:
-                linux.*:    # linux64 and 32 get same treatment here
-                    EN_US_PACKAGE_NAME: target.tar.xz
-                    EN_US_BINARY_URL:
-                        artifact-reference: <build/{artifact_prefix}>
+                linux.*:
+                    MOZ_ARTIFACT_TASK: {task-reference: '<build>'}
                 macosx64.*:
-                    EN_US_PACKAGE_NAME: target.dmg
-                    EN_US_BINARY_URL:
-                        artifact-reference: <build/{artifact_prefix}>
+                    MOZ_ARTIFACT_TASK: {task-reference: '<build>'}
                 win.*:
-                    EN_US_PACKAGE_NAME: target.zip
-                    EN_US_BINARY_URL:
-                        artifact-reference: <build-signing/{artifact_prefix}>
+                    MOZ_ARTIFACT_TASK: {task-reference: '<build-signing>'}
         mozharness:
             comm-checkout: true
             config-paths:
diff --git a/taskcluster/kinds/shippable-l10n/kind.yml b/taskcluster/kinds/shippable-l10n/kind.yml
index 26731338f2a..b50ceb18b4a 100644
--- a/taskcluster/kinds/shippable-l10n/kind.yml
+++ b/taskcluster/kinds/shippable-l10n/kind.yml
@@ -97,18 +97,12 @@ tasks:
                     win64-shippable: windows2012-64-shippable/opt
         env:
             by-build-platform:
-                linux.*:   # linux64 and 32 get same treatment here
-                    EN_US_PACKAGE_NAME: target.tar.xz
-                    EN_US_BINARY_URL:
-                        artifact-reference: <build-signing/{artifact_prefix}>
+                linux.*:
+                    MOZ_ARTIFACT_TASK: {task-reference: '<build-signing>'}
                 macosx64.*:
-                    EN_US_PACKAGE_NAME: target.dmg
-                    EN_US_BINARY_URL:
-                        artifact-reference: <repackage/{artifact_prefix}>
+                    MOZ_ARTIFACT_TASK: {task-reference: '<repackage>'}
                 win.*:
-                    EN_US_PACKAGE_NAME: target.zip
-                    EN_US_BINARY_URL:
-                        artifact-reference: <build-signing/{artifact_prefix}>
+                    MOZ_ARTIFACT_TASK: {task-reference: '<build-signing>'}
         mozharness:
             comm-checkout: true
             config-paths:
title: Bug 1967173 - Port bug 1966470: Make Desktop single-locale repacks fetch using artifact build logic rather than `wget-en-US`. r=darktrojan
